profiles.name: Aiman Athirah Sabu
profiles.position: Deputy Minister of Housing and Local Government
profiles.description: Aiman Athirah Sabu represents Sepang, Selangor, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Deputy Minister of Housing and Local Government. A AMANAH member.

profiles.name: Lim Lip Eng
profiles.description: Lim Lip Eng represents Kepong, Kuala Lumpur, in the Dewan Rakyat. A DAP member.

profiles.name: Prabakaran Parameswaran
profiles.description: Prabakaran Parameswaran represents Batu, Kuala Lumpur, in the Dewan Rakyat. A PKR member.

milestones.title: Provide school-supply packages to 500 Sepang children
milestones.description: Aiman Athirah’s constituency centre reported packages worth RM183 each, delivered with Yayasan Taqwa MAIWP and the religious-affairs minister’s assistance.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers the reported 500-child handover. The RM3.7 million wider constituency allocation and education budget are not this programme’s completion percentage.

milestones.title: Distribute Ramadan contributions to Sepang mosques and suraus
milestones.description: Aiman Athirah reported contributions to 40 mosques and about 20 Friday-prayer suraus at the 19 February Ihya Ramadan launch.
milestones.progress_note: The reported institutional handover is complete. The RM490,380 overall Ramadan programme budget, later visits, rice distribution and planned March event are not all verified deliveries.

milestones.title: Secure funding for resurfacing Seroja apartments’ road and parking area
milestones.description: A China Press clipping archived by DBKL reports RM200,000 secured by Lim Lip Eng and completed road and parking resurfacing at Seroja apartments.
milestones.progress_note: A historical February 2024 delivery report involving ICU funding and council coordination. The headline and clipping were checked; later road condition and satisfaction were not independently measured.

methodology: Dated public commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. An evidence-only record has no invented earlier promise. Status is tied to its evidence snapshot and shared agency responsibility is explicit. Historical activity is not a live November performance measurement. Allocations, attendance, sales orders and unrelated programme ratios are not completion percentages. Additional research may extend this initial pass.
